response_detail: Your billing record needs to be refreshed before plan changes can continue.

root_cause.summary: Recovery regenerate called StripeService.create_upgrade_session for a MODE_UNVERIFIED client; upgrade/portal preflight raised StripeModeDriftError and the route mapped all exceptions to HTTP 500.

client_context_at_probe.case_note: Prior guided closeout mutated state; billing row still MODE_UNVERIFIED remediation

fix_direction.summary: For MODE_UNVERIFIED / regenerate-checkout remediation, use deployment-mode create_checkout_session instead of upgrade preflight; map governed drift to 409/422 instead of 500.
preserve: state machine transitions after successful checkout creation
